query:
SELECT weekNumber, subgroup, headcount, updatedAt, weekStartDate
FROM attendance_weekly 
WHERE year = 2026 AND weekNumber IN (19, 20) AND campus = 'Canton' 
  AND subgroup = 'Revolution Canton Check-In'
ORDER BY weekNumber;
